bowlers should have a good day. As a team, we keep wickets in hand and go full-on in 
the last five overs. That is the idea and I try to do that. I am not trying to be consistent 
but trying to react well to create more chances than going flat. I faced Nortje last year 
but [Archer] felt quicker. He got a bit of purchase from tis wicket, so I felt it quicker 
compared to Nortje. Feel slower one and change of pace is holding on the wicket, so it 
is a good score."
